slowest_experiments.experiment: V615 independent evidence capstone and V616 handoff
Bounded belief-query API for the ARC policy

summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 0.9 minutes, including 3 compute-bound experiments. The provenance-complete live belief shadow trace was the longest listed compute-bound experiment at 0.57 minutes, but the supplied data do not show why it took longest or establish whole-task GPU efficiency.
bottlenecks_identified: Disk-mtime reconstruction gives experiment totals but no phase-level cause for the longest compute-bound experiment.
The GPU snapshot is not correlated with compute-task start and end times, so it cannot establish whole-task utilization efficiency.
No data available this milestone identifies whether a compute-bound task loaded 2 or more models in parallel or whether DualGPURunner applied.
improvements_suggested: Record monotonic start, end, and phase timings for each experiment instead of relying on disk modification times.
Capture task-scoped GPU utilization only during compute-bound task windows and store it with each experiment record.
Record model count and dispatch topology, and select DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models load in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add per-phase monotonic timing to the experiment harness.
Attach task-window GPU telemetry to each compute-bound experiment.
Add model-count-aware dispatch telemetry and conditional DualGPURunner selection.
meta_reflection: The evidence supports a duration ranking and records no compute-bound GPU-idle fault. It does not support a causal explanation, a whole-task GPU-efficiency verdict, a parallel-model runner verdict, or a positive time-savings estimate.
